- [2026-09-10-structural-diff-oss](../../../plite/research/2026-09-10-structural-diff-oss). Validates Plite's structural document diff plan against several diff, merge and CRDT engines, and states ProseMirror facts through prosemirror-changeset.
- [2026-09-11-large-documents-contract](../../../plite/research/2026-09-11-large-documents-contract). Plite large-document rendering, pagination, coverage and packaging contract, with pinned source reads of ProseMirror viewdesc (composing-node identity), Lexical's reconciler, the Slate chunking walkthrough, and CodeMirror and TanStack as cross-editor evidence.
- [2026-09-14-docx-interoperability-oss](../../../plite/research/2026-09-14-docx-interoperability-oss). It audits Plate's DOCX import, export and Word-paste owners (sidecar authority, the duplicate review serializer, two bug reproductions, 135 replayed tests) and compares six DOCX source families (Mammoth, html-to-docx, docx, docx-preview, SuperDoc, Pandoc), none of which has an editor home, so the cross-tool conversion comparison goes to editor-architecture.
- [2026-09-15-docx-post-implementation-oss](../../../plite/research/2026-09-15-docx-post-implementation-oss). Reassesses Plate's DOCX import/export retained-source contract against a comparison table of eight DOCX engines (OpenDoc, Scriptor, Folio, EigenPal, docx-cli, docx-redline-js, Open XML SDK, python-docx); none of them is a listed editor home.
- [2026-09-17-table-substrate-ownership](../../../plite/research/2026-09-17-table-substrate-ownership). It decides how Plate's table feature, its copied UI and Plite's selection and host-lifetime owners split selection, resize and paint (plite, including a Happy DOM probe of the real paint hook), by comparing table selection and resize ownership across editors (editor-architecture), with source-level facts about prosemirror-tables and prosemirror-state (prosemirror), Tiptap's extension-table (tiptap), @lexical/table and its playground resizer (lexical), ProseKit's table-handle and resizable components (prosekit), and Milkdown's preset-gfm table commands and view (milkdown). Second reader added yjs-collaboration.
- [2026-09-21-annotation-architecture-oss](../../../plite/research/2026-09-21-annotation-architecture-oss). Validates the Plite anchor, exact-view annotation index and paint ownership against ProseMirror decorations/bookmarks, Lexical MarkNode/comments, Tiptap Comments, Yjs relative positions and Automerge cursors, plus CodeMirror, Monaco and Quill, which have no home and go to editor-architecture.
- [2026-09-21-media-object-editable-content](../../../plite/research/2026-09-21-media-object-editable-content). Plite media object versus editable-caption semantics, backed by local Plate model probes and compared with ProseMirror atom/contentDOM, WordGard CaptionedFigure and Lexical DecoratorNode nested editors and named slots.
- [2026-09-24-export-architecture](../../../plite/research/2026-09-24-export-architecture). A first-principles review of Plate/Plite whole-document export ownership that compares source-level export contracts of prosemirror-model and prosemirror-markdown, Tiptap, Lexical, and BlockNote, CKEditor 5 and Quill (no homes of their own), so it compares editors.
- [2026-09-25-document-codec-architecture](../../../plite/research/2026-09-25-document-codec-architecture). Plate/Plite import-export codec API research (adopted). Its shard 004 and read log state source-level facts about ProseMirror (DOM parse vs parseSlice, separate Markdown parser and serializer), Tiptap (detached HTML/Markdown conversion, happy-dom server path), Lexical (conversion needs editor and global DOM context) and Portable Text (detached schema-aware conversion with unknown-node fallback), and compares them as cross-editor conversion architecture.
- [2026-10-02-agentic-e2e-testing](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-agentic-e2e-testing). Mostly Plate proof tooling: it judges tester-army e2e and the mobile agent tools against @platejs/test and the Playwright suites, then builds Plite's local Android Gboard and macOS Pinyin lanes, audits Plite's `__pliteBrowserHandle`, and drafts Plite IME bugs (plite); shard 005 and about 79 read-log rows rank Android cases from Slate's issue tracker and read Slate's android-input-manager, RestoreDOM, android-tests page and Playwright config (slate); shard 006 cites Lexical's CDP imeSetComposition e2e and ProseMirror's synthetic CompositionEvent tests as prior art (lexical, prosemirror) and compares how editors test IME, concluding none drives a real OS IME (editor-architecture).
- [2026-10-02-autocomplete-query-representation](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-autocomplete-query-representation). Compares where trigger autocomplete keeps its query across editors, with source-cited facts on Lexical, Slate, Tiptap, ProseKit, Milkdown and ProseMirror (prosemirror-view, inputrules, issue #903), plus Plate's own probes and the history of its 2024 combobox design, ending in a Plate autocomplete verdict.
- [2026-10-02-dnd-landing-policy](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-dnd-landing-policy). Plite transfer landing pipeline and Plate DnD feature rules mapped file by file, then compared with source-read drop-target, handle and container policy in ProseMirror, Tiptap, BlockNote, Lexical, ProseKit, Slate (zbeyens fork) and CKEditor 5.
- [2026-10-02-dnd-library-choice](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-dnd-library-choice). Keeps Plite's native drag driver and transfer owner and the copied DndKit over Pragmatic DnD, dnd-kit and React DnD, and a cross-editor table states drag implementation and test-limit facts for ProseMirror, Tiptap, Lexical, a Slate fork and BlockNote.
- [2026-10-03-autocomplete-arena](../../../plite/research/2026-10-03-autocomplete-arena). Design arena for Plate's ordinary-text autocomplete owner (combobox host, slots, useCombobox) and the Plite input facts it depends on (typed-text origin stamp, focus, IME keys, settleInput); it compares design candidates, not editors.
- [2026-10-06-docx-native-state](../../../plite/research/2026-10-06-docx-native-state). Judges Plate's hidden DOCX `editor/authored.json` envelope against 15 editor and DOCX-library clones; Tiptap (DOCX only as a Pro/cloud feature, none in the tree) and Wordgard (no DOCX code) each get a sourced disposition. Second reader removed tiptap, wordgard.
